description: Form 8582 instructions (2025), PTP example: 'You have a Schedule E loss of $12,000 (current year losses plus prior year unallowed losses) and Form 4797 gain of $7,200 from the passive activities of a PTP. ... you report $7,200 of the losses as a passive loss ... You carry forward the unallowed loss of $4,800 ($12,000 − $7,200).' Here $9,000 current loss + $3,000 prior, the $7,200 gain entered in the gain facts.
